title: Agency Schema
description: Schema for agency changes in Producerflow

agency_id.description: Always present. Unique identifier for the agency

external_id.description: Only present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the agency

fein.description: Always present if agency is not a sole proprietor. Federal Employer Identification Number

npn.description: Always present if agency is not a sole proprietor. National Producer Number

agency_data.description: Present when agency is created or updated. Contains basic agency information

is_sole_proprietor.description: Whether the agency is a sole proprietorship

agency_address.description: Present when agency is created or when agency addresses change. Contains address information for the agency

agency_bank_account.description: Present when agency is created or when agency bank account changes. Contains bank account information for the agency

agency_eo.description: Present when agency is created or when E&O coverage changes. Contains E&O insurance information for the agency

agency_ivans_account.description: Present when agency is created or when IVANS account changes. Contains IVANS integration information for the agency

agency_nipr_data.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the agency. Contains agency information from NIPR

agency_nipr_appointments.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the agency. Contains all current carrier appointments from NIPR

agency_nipr_licenses.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the agency. Contains all current licenses with their LOAs from NIPR

agency_nipr_addresses.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the agency. Contains all addresses from NIPR

requested_appointment_states.description: Present when agency is created with requested appointment states or when the requested appointment states are updated. Contains the list of appointment states requested for the agency during onboarding

nipr_sync_status.description: Always present. NIPR synchronization status of the agency (disabled, pending, failing, active)

nipr_sync_status_updated_at.description: Always present. ISO 8601 timestamp when the NIPR synchronization status was last updated

organization.description: Present when the agency's organization assignment changes. Contains organization details.

organization_id.description: Unique internal identifier for the organization

external_id.description: External identifier for the organization from an external system

unassigned.description: Only present when true, indicates the agency has been removed from this organization. When this happens, the other fields contain details about the organization to which the agency was previously assigned

agency_principal.description: Always present if the agency has a principal. Contains principal information for the agency

principal_id.description: Always present. Unique identifier for the principal

principal_external_id.description: Only present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the principal

tenant_additional_questions.description: Present when agency is created, updated, or when NIPR data is synced. Contains custom additional questions and answers as key-value pairs collected during agency onboarding

locations.description: Present when agency is created or when agency locations change. Contains all current locations for the agency

state.description: State or province of this location

phone.description: Contact phone number for this location

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary location for the agency

contract_status.description: Present when agency contract status changes. Current status of the agency's contract
